learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will learn how to connect words and sentences using joining words (Conjunctions) like and, but, or, and because.]
warm_up_hook: 🚂 How do train compartments stick together? They use a strong hook! In grammar, we use special words called Conjunctions to hook words and sentences together so they don't break apart!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: A Conjunction is a joining word. It connects words, groups of words, or short sentences together to make one longer, better sentence.
examples_or_templates: Instead of: 'I like apples. I like bananas.'

lesson_modules.teaching_content: We use 'And' to join two similar ideas or things that go together. We use 'But' to join two different, opposite, or surprising ideas.
examples_or_templates: [And]: She bought a pen and a notebook. (Similar things)
[But]: I ran fast, but I missed the bus. (Opposite/surprising result)

lesson_modules.teaching_content: We use 'Or' when we have a CHOICE between two things. We use 'Because' to give a REASON or answer the question 'Why?'.
examples_or_templates: [Or]: Do you want tea or coffee? (Choice)
[Because]: I am wearing a sweater because it is cold. (Reason)

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which conjunction fits best? 'Is the box heavy ____ light?'
❓ Choose the correct joining word: 'He was crying _______ he fell down.'

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Join the sentences using 'And': 'The sun is shining. The birds are singing.'
subjective_practice.hint: Remove the full stop in the middle and put your joining word there. Remember to make the 'T' in 'The birds' small!

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blank with 'But' or 'Because': 'I wanted to play outside, _______ it started raining.'
subjective_practice.hint: Are these two ideas similar, or is the rain stopping the plan (an opposite idea)?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blank: 'You can use a pencil ____ a pen for the drawing.'
subjective_practice.hint: You have to choose one of them!

activity_or_assignment.title: ✂️ The Sentence Puzzle
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Write down 3 sentences starting with 'I like...' and 3 sentences starting with 'because...'. Try to join them together. (e.g., 'I like Sundays' + 'because I get to eat ice cream!')

chapter_summary: ⭐ Conjunctions are joining words that connect words or sentences.
⭐ 'Or' is used to show a choice between things.
⭐ 'Because' tells us the reason why something happened.
